The KnightLoader browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Firefox.

## 🎨 Design

- **Set in Noto Sans**, shipped with the extension, so it looks the same on every system. Chinese, Japanese and Korean keep the system's own font.
- **Follows GlimStone 2.9.0.** A button's icon is the size of its label, disco glides round the colour wheel instead of jumping from colour to colour, every window has its way out as a button in its bottom row, and the default motion level is Subtle.
- **Buy Me a Coffee opens in a window** on the About card, with PayPal and crypto beside it.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Explanations sit in (i) bubbles**, the crypto window's introduction among them. Escape on an (i) closes the bubble first and the window on the next press.
- **The language picker changes only once you click or tab into it**, so scrolling the page past it leaves the language alone.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A tooltip no longer stays up after a click.** Focus opens a tooltip only after keyboard input.
- **The paste and reveal buttons in the phrase field sit side by side** instead of on top of each other.
- **Dragging a rainbow colour keeps every step.** Two steps of a drag could overlap, and the later one wrote the earlier colour back.
- **A name with a dollar sign shows as typed** in the sentences around it.

## 🌐 Translations

- The new and reworded texts in all 42 languages. German calls rainbow mode „Regenbogen-Modus“ everywhere.
